jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* Own the Cash product agenda across the Digital channels, with strategic accountability for translating Cash and Payments priorities into scalable capabilities across Host-to-Host (H2H), SWIFT and Common Channel Services (CCS).
* Lead the development, prioritisation and commercialisation of channel capabilities and features, ensuring investment is anchored in clear client use cases, measurable commercial value, regulatory needs and end-to-end client outcomes.
* Lead and develop a team of Product Owners to convert strategy into an executable global roadmap and deliver consistent, secure and reusable Cash Digital capabilities across markets, client segments and connectivity models.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy, portfolio and business partnership**

* Own the global Cash channel strategy and roadmap across Web, H2H, SWIFT and CCS, aligning country, regional and global demand to business priorities.
* Act as the senior Channels counterpart to Cash Product heads and represent the portfolio in senior governance, investment and prioritisation forums.
* Partner with global, regional and country Cash Product heads to understand business, client and product priorities in every market.
* Manage senior stakeholders across global product and country management, Channels and Technology, setting expectations on scope, timing and trade-offs. Make transparent trade-offs across growth, client commitments, regulatory or scheme deadlines, resilience, simplification and platform modernisation.

**Product execution and prioritisation**

* Own the global Cash backlog for Channels and rank demand using commercial value, client impact, regulatory urgency, risk, effort and delivery feasibility.
* Lead the working relationship between Cash, country, Channel Product and Technology teams to agree scope, dependencies, release plans and accountable outcomes.
* Run one intake process for all demand, sorting each request, assess client requests tied to mandates /RFPs and implementation deadlines, track regulatory requirements against deadlines.
* Apply a clear prioritisation framework, ringfence capacity across regulatory, client driven scope on revenue and client priority, and sequence delivery. Spot common needs across markets to deliver them as global capabilities.
* Maintain executive oversight of multiple initiatives running in parallel across markets, products and channels, keep a portfolio view of status, risks, milestones and cross-channel dependencies, intervening early where delivery or value is at risk.

**Client insight, proposition and commercialisation**

* Build evidence-based country and client use cases covering target segments, revenue and volumes at stake, adoption barriers, competitive gaps and the cost of not acting.
* Define differentiated value propositions and commercialisation plans for new capabilities, partnering with Sales, Implementation, Onboarding and Client Service to drive launch readiness and adoption.
* Track adoption, transaction volumes, client feedback and realised benefits after launch, using insights to refine the proposition and roadmap.

**Cross-channel capability and solution leadership**

* Translate Cash and Payments needs into end-to-end capabilities spanning digital journeys, entitlements, approvals, connectivity, formats, payment status and reporting.

jobs.title: AI Builder (Senior Product Designer)
jobs.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
  
  
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
  
  
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
  
  
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
  
  
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
  
  
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
  
  
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
  
  
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
  
  
**About The Role**
This role exists because we believe the future of design is fundamentally agentic. You're not here to use AI as a productivity tool - you're here to redesign the entire practice of design itself. Part engineer, part designer, part systems architect, entirely at the frontier.

jobs.description:
**InMobi (Corporate)**
InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.
  
  
**InMobi Advertising**
InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.
  
  
**Glance**
Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.
  
  
**About Accelerate**
Accelerate is InMobi’s AI-native, self-serve campaign management platform for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies and enterprise advertisers. An advertiser describes their brand and goals; Accelerate’s agents plan, create, launch and optimize campaigns across ad platforms such as TikTok and OpenAI, with more supply integrations on the way.
  
  
We are building toward a fully autonomous marketing platform. The product team is organized by capability, not segment. This role sits on the demand side, reporting to the Group Product Manager, alongside Customer Experience Core (campaign creation, onboarding and activation).
  
  
**About The Role**
You will build Accelerate’s payments and money infrastructure from zero. Every dollar or rupee an advertiser puts into Accelerate flows through what you build: how they fund their account, how spend is drawn down across ad platforms, how they are invoiced, refunded and taxed, and how we settle with suppliers.
  
  
There is no legacy system to inherit. You will define the wallet, the ledger behind it, and the integration with our third-party payments partner (Vyre), then own the revenue metrics that depend on them. Getting this right is what lets an SMB go from signup to live campaign in minutes, and what lets finance trust every number on the dashboard.
  
  
You will work with a Senior Product Associate on the pod, engineering, Central Design, and InMobi finance, tax and legal teams.

* Advertiser wallet. A prepaid balance advertisers top up and Accelerate draws down as campaigns spend. Includes funding methods, auto-recharge, low-balance alerts, credit lines for larger accounts, and the rules for how a balance can and cannot be used.

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Jupiter**

Jupiter is a money app for people who are building their lives in India. From one app you can open a savings account with our partner bank, pay on UPI, save towards goals in Pots, borrow, buy insurance, invest, and see where your money actually goes. Our Edge+ CSB Bank RuPay credit card works on UPI and earns Jewels, our rewards currency, on the brands people already shop with.

We are a product company at heart. We obsess over small details, we read what customers tell us, and we would rather do fewer things properly than many things badly.

**Why this role exists**

AI is already part of how Jupiter works. Our product team uses an in-house assistant that reads our Confluence, Figma, Amplitude, Databricks and support tickets to answer questions and draft PRDs, right inside Slack. Engineering has a bot that turns a Jira ticket into a draft pull request. Marketing has a creative studio that designs ads, critiques its own work against a checklist and tells us what every run cost.

Those started as tools for us. The next step is bigger: putting AI in front of customers in a product that handles their money, where a confident wrong answer is not a small bug. We are looking for a PM who wants to own that problem, with the judgement to know where AI helps and the discipline to prove it before it ships.

**What you will do**

* **Find the problems worth solving with AI.**
  Explaining a declined payment, making sense of a card bill, help that actually closes the ticket, a Money tab that answers questions in plain words. You will also say no to the ideas where a better screen would do the job.
* **Own products end to end.**
  Problem, PRD, evals, launch, and the numbers after launch. You stay with it until it works for customers, not until it is merged.
* **Write the evals before the feature.**
  Define what good looks like with real examples, build the test sets with engineering, and decide the score that is good enough to ship. When the model changes, you know within a day whether things got better or worse.
* **Design for the moments AI gets it wrong.**
  What the assistant says when it does not know, when it hands over to a person, and how a customer corrects it. These moments decide whether people trust us.
* **Keep it safe and compliant.**
  Work with compliance, risk and our partner banks so everything we build respects RBI guidelines, the DPDP Act and our partners' policies. Customer data stays where it belongs.
* **Treat cost and speed as product decisions.**
  Know what each conversation costs, pick the right model for each job, and cut what does not earn its keep.
* **Raise the bar for the whole team.**
  Help other PMs, designers and analysts use AI well in their own work, and keep improving the internal tools they already rely on.

**Your first 90 days**

* **By day 30:**
  you use Jupiter every day, have read a few hundred support conversations, have sat with ops and compliance, and know our internal AI tools by using them.
* **By day 60:**
  you have picked one customer problem, made the case for it with real data, and put a working prototype in front of colleagues.
* **By day 90:**
  you have an eval set, a launch plan with guardrails, and a small rollout to real customers with one clear success metric.

**You will do well here if you**

* Have 4 to 8 years in product, with at least one AI or ML product shipped to real users. A demo does not count; something people used does.
* Can explain in plain words how l

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Payments Fintech
jobs.description:
**About The Company**
Merge is a regulated stablecoin payments infrastructure platform enabling enterprises to move money globally in real time. We combine stablecoin rails with local instant payment systems to deliver faster, cheaper, and more transparent cross-border payments and treasury workflows.
  
  
Merge serves fintechs, investment platforms, marketplaces, and corporate treasury teams globally.
  
  
**About The Role**
At Merge, we are driven by innovation and a commitment to excellence in the fintech space. As a Product Manager, you will be crucial in executing product strategies that align with our company’s mission to revolutionize global banking and payments. Our team values include customer focus, meticulous craftsmanship, relentless curiosity and innovation. We are looking for a dynamic problem solver who thrives on new challenges, has a passion for launching fintech products and can effectively communicate across all levels of the organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive API-first initiatives and ensure seamless integration with third-party systems.
* Publish product requirement documents with low-fidelity wireframes and measurable metrics to define success.
* Collaborate with engineering, design, marketing, and sales teams to deliver innovative products. Most importantly, work collaboratively with other product managers.
* Gather and prioritize product requirements from various stakeholders, including customers and internal teams.
* Lead the product development lifecycle from ideation to launch, ensuring timely delivery of features and enhancements.
* Monitor product performance and iterate based on feedback and analytics to continuously improve user experience.
* Act as the voice of the customer and advocate for their needs throughout the development process.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* Relevant 5+ years of experience in product management within a B2B fintech organisation with an API platform.
* Strong technical background to understand APIs.
* Experience in managing the entire product lifecycle from concept to launch.
* Proven track record of delivering successful products in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to unblock themselves, with a high aptitude for problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication (this is a must in a global set-up) and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Proficiency in product management tools and methodologies.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of product features.

**Good-to-Have Qualifications**

* Knowledge of the global fintech landscape and trends in fiat, cross-border or crypto products.

jobs.description:
Give every finance team AI agents that do their most painful work for them.
  
  
**The role**
Finance teams carry some of the most manual, high-stakes work in any company, and spreadsheets and ERPs never solved it. They are already among the heaviest builders on Isomorph. Now we are building a finance platform on top of it: ready-made apps and agents, finance-specific experiences and the integrations that make finance problems easy to solve from day one.
  
  
You will own it from zero: what we build, who it is for, and how it wins. It is a rare chance to build a product line at the intersection of AI and finance, inside a platform that is already being used.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* The finance product strategy: which problems we solve first, for whom, and why.
* Ready-made finance agents and apps that teams adopt in days and extend with their own AI.
* The integrations finance teams need most.
* The trust a CFO and an auditor need before they rely on it.
* Taking it to market with our sales team and partners.

**What You’ll Get To Build Next**

* Build the finance know-how that, over time, becomes finance-specific AI of our own.
* Build toward finance operations that largely run themselves, with people focused on judgment.

**You’ll thrive here if**

* You have built finance or fintech products, or worked in finance and moved into product.
* You know how finance teams really work, from the close to the audit.
* You are excited about AI agents and realistic about where people stay in the loop.
* You are as comfortable with a CFO as with an engineer.

**Why Isomorph**
For fifty years, software inside a company has been written by a small group of engineers, for everyone else. That is ending. With AI, the people who know the work best (the finance analyst, the ops lead, the recruiter, the support manager) can now build the software they need themselves. Most of them have never written a line of code.
  
  
This is one of the biggest shifts in how companies work, and it has a missing piece. The software these people build is useful, and very often unsafe: no sign-in, sensitive data exposed, nobody to run it, and invisible to IT. Multiply that across a large company and you get thousands of apps and agents that nobody governs.
  
  
**Isomorph is the foundation that software runs on.**
Bring an app or agent built with any AI tool, and Isomorph runs it on the company’s own cloud: secured, connected to company data and systems, monitored and kept healthy. Builders never think about infrastructure. IT stays in control of everything.
  
  
We believe every company will become AI-native one workflow at a time, built by its own people. Isomorph is where that software will live.
  
  
**The team.**
You will join a small, high-talent-density founding team from IIT Madras and IIT Delhi. The founders are second-time founders who have built companies before and sold one.
  
  
**Why you’ll love it here**

* You’ll be early. You will be one of the first people on the team, with real ownership and a real say in what Isomorph becomes.
* You’ll work at the frontier. AI agents and enterprise-grade infrastructure, applied to a problem every company is about to have.
* You’ll see your impact. We work side by side with customers, so what you ship is in real people’s hands within days.
* You’ll build the way the future builds. We build Isomorph with AI agents ourselves, so your leverage is your judgment and your taste, not your typing speed.

People build lives across borders, and Aspora helps the Indian diaspora send money home and grow wealth in India. Growth here is won in a user’s first three months: a friend’s referral, a first transfer, a return next month. This role exists to turn that journey into a growth engine that compounds with every new cohort. You will own growth for our product, working closely with design, engineering, data and our CLM team.

jobs.title: Community and Brand Lead
jobs.description:
**Note:** Tarlan is recruiting a Community and Brand Lead for Bindbee, an Software Infrastructure SaaS startup. Tarlan is a recruiting firm managing this search.

  

**About Bindbee**

Bindbee is a unified API for HR, payroll and benefits systems. Companies building benefits, HR and insurance software connect once instead of building and maintaining separate integrations with Workday, ADP, UKG, Paycom and 110+ other systems.

  

Its customers are US companies: benefits administrators, TPAs, ICHRA platforms, benefits navigation apps and HR-tech products. Teams like ThrivePass, Newfront and Healthee run on Bindbee. The company is SOC 2, ISO, GDPR and HIPAA compliant.

  

Bindbee is profitable, serves 100+ customers, and about one in three customers refers a new one. This role turns that existing advocacy into something built deliberately.

  

**The role**

Youll build two things: a brand buyers recognize and a community they want to be part of. Both are judged on whether the right buyers know Bindbee and whether they bring in pipeline.

  

There is no community like this in Bindbees market today. The people running benefits, payroll and HR data at TPAs, benefits platforms and HR-tech companies lack a shared place to learn from each other. Youll decide who it serves, what it offers and why people would show up. Nothing is handed to you.

  

The community must help members first. It cannot be a Bindbee sales channel with a different name. Trust, recognition and peer referrals are what create pipeline.

  

This is a **hands-on individual contributor role**. You set the direction and do the work: posts, invites, calls, events and follow-ups.

  

**What youll do**

* **Build the brand and find the audience.** Own Bindbees presence on LinkedIn, X and wherever its buyers spend time. Shape its voice and content, map the groups, newsletters, podcasts, events and creators buyers follow, and bring Bindbee into those conversations.
* **Design and launch the community.** Define who it serves, what members gain, where it lives and how they join. Recruit the first members through customers, partners and existing networks, then expand into the wider market.
* **Run programming people return for.** Organize expert sessions, conversations across member segments, AMAs, a research newsletter and virtual events. Bring trusted operators, analysts and creators in as guests, co-hosts and collaborators.
* **Turn trust into measurable pipeline.** Identify members with real integration needs and hand them to sales with context. Track referrals, meetings, community growth and activity, and brand reach and engagement among ideal customers.
* **Work with the team.** Pull stories from customers, founders, sales and product, and share what you hear from the market.

  

**Who you are**

* **You have built a community from zero.** You started it, found the first members and got people to returnnot just joined or moderated an existing one.
* **You have grown a B2B brand organically.** You built a company or founders following on LinkedIn or X without paid ads and can show what worked.
* **You balance member trust with business outcomes.** You understand that a community must give before it gets and can explain how your work generated business while protecting that trust. You care about relevant awareness and meetings, beyond likes and follower counts.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**  

At Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early.

In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend.

We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds.

Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules.

  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities**  

Your Daily Work: The 9 Core Areas

Your job will be very hands-on. You will not just be sitting in long meetings talking about big ideas. You will be doing the real, detailed work to make this AI smart. Here are the nine specific areas you will be working on every day:

* 1. FPR (Future Press Release)  
  Before a single line of computer code is written, you have to know what your end goal is. We do this by writing a Future Press Release, or FPR.  
  A press release is a news article that a company puts out when they launch a cool new product. But here, you will write this news article before we even start building. You will write it as if the product is already finished and launched to the public. You will write a catchy headline like: "Bajaj Finance Launches AI That Solves Loan Issues in 10 Seconds." You will write quotes from pretend customers talking about how much they love the feature. You will explain exactly what problem the feature solves in simple, everyday language.  
  Why do we do thisBecause it keeps everyone focused. If the news article sounds boring or confusing, it means your idea is probably boring or confusing. Once you write a great FPR, you show it to the engineers and your bosses. When everyone reads it and says, "Wow, this sounds amazing, let's build it!"-that document becomes your team's guide.
* 2. FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions)  
  Along with your news article, you will write a massive list of Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ). But these are not just the normal questions a customer might ask. These are questions that anyone involved might ask.  
  You have to put yourself in the shoes of a confused customer. What will they ask"Is my bank data safe with this AI robot" You write the answer. You have to think like our call center agents. "Will this AI do my job wrong and make the customer angry" You write the answer. You have to think like our company lawyers. "Does this AI follow the Reserve Bank of India rule

**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
**About The Role**
You’ll help us build the next generation of systems that help us run multi region, scalable processes to identify customers who they say they are and ensure any processes minimise the chance of financial crime manifesting throughout a customers lifecycle. You’ll be embedded in one of our product teams, partner with Product, Engineering, Ops and Compliance to improve control effectiveness, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Work on the KYC analytics ‘3 body problems’ of risk, friction and cost

* Help design scalable platforms

+ This is a team about building sustainable, long term foundations
+ This isn’t about short term growth hacking - you’ll help build a long lasting platform

* Embody a data-as-a-product mentality

* Stakeholder partnership

+ Shape the ‘what next’ for product outcomes

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our consumer data platform. We have a modern cloud lakehouse in place and are now building the consumer data foundation on top of it: a canonical data model, a consumer data warehouse, and one trusted source of data for analytics, data science, risk and finance teams.
  
  
You’ll own the roadmap from the start. You’ll decide which use cases to deliver first, define how core consumer entities are modeled, and make sure each new use case builds on shared data instead of one-off pipelines. You’ll work closely with data engineering, data architecture, analytics and risk teams.
  
  
*This is not a dashboard-building role. You’ll own the data, definitions and metrics that dashboards, models and reports are built on.*
What you’ll do in your first 12 months
  
  

* Build a prioritized backlog of consumer data use cases with analytics, data science, risk and finance, and decide which 3–5 to deliver first.
* Define canonical consumer entities, such as customer, account, transaction, fee, merchant, country and currency, so they mean the same thing across products.
* Decide where products share a common model and where they need their own structures, and document the reasoning.
* Define single, governed definitions for core consumer KPIs such as active customers, revenue per user, lifetime value and churn.
* Write requirements engineers can build from: source-to-target mappings, grain, keys, history rules and data-quality checks.
* Track adoption: which teams have moved to the new models, how much they’re being used, and how many metric discrepancies have been resolved.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or an M

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Social Networking
jobs.description:
**Building the Future of Open Finance**
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
  
  
**The team**
Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
  
  
We’re hiring a Product Manager with deep UX and interaction design expertise to build social experiences around investing and trading at Kraken.
  
  
You should be comfortable designing flows yourself, building interactive prototypes, and working through interaction details with designers and engineers. You’ll also own the product decisions: which customer problem to solve, what to ship first, and how to measure whether the experience improved.
  
  
**The opportunity**

* Design complete social journeys. Work through how someone discovers a person, decides to follow them, shares an idea or trade, receives a response, and returns. Connect these interactions into an experience users understand without explanation.
* Make the interaction details work. Shape navigation, information hierarchy, copy, defaults, gestures, and feedback. Specify what happens when a feed is empty, a post fails, content loads slowly, or someone changes their mind.
* Prototype before committing to a build. Turn ideas into interactive prototypes that communicate the intended behavior. Explore alternatives, test the uncertain parts, and give engineering clear flows, states, and acceptance criteria.
* Use psychology to improve participation. Understand why people hesitate to post, seek recognition, follow strangers, or respond to others. Translate those motivations into decisions about audience visibility, prompts, reputation, feedback, and the effort required to contribute.
* Observe users and fix what gets in their way. Run usability sessions, watch people complete tasks, and combine those observations with funnel data. Identify where people misunderstand the product, lose confidence, or abandon an action.
* Design for first use and repeated use. Make the experience useful before someone has connections. Keep sharing lightweight during an active trading session, with clear control over what becomes public. Test the twentieth interaction as carefully as the first.
* Connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. For each significant change, define the expected behavior and how to test it. Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention. Work with data science to evaluate experiments and effects on both contributors and their audiences.
* Take the experience through launch. Choose a focused initial scope, resolve trade-offs with engineering, review the implementation against the intended design, and use post-launch evidence to decide what to improve next.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Edenred**
Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.
  
  
Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.
  
  
Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.
  
  
True to the Group's purpose, “Enrich connections. For good.”, these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.
  
  
Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.
  
  
In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.
  
  
Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.
  
  
**The UAE CONTEXT**
Edenred UAE is a fast-growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 businesses and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions.
  
  
We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll, and for employees to receive their salaries and use them in the simplest way — through multiple value-added services in our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge, card services and more).
  
  
**THE ROLE**
Most of our users receive their salary on a card we issue, send money home through our app, and pay for their week with a product our team built. For a large share of them, we are their first and only financial relationship. That raises the stakes on every decision — and makes this one of the more interesting product jobs in the region.
  
  
You will own product strategy and delivery for a product area inside an organisation that has the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a multinational. You set direction for your area, shape its strategy, and make day-to-day calls that are demonstrably aligned to a clear product vision — with the coaching and air cover to get it right.
  
  
Depending on where the business needs you most, you might begin in financial crime and compliance — making onboarding fast without weakening controls, catching fraud earlier, turning regulatory requirements into changes engineering can actually build. Or you might begin on the consumer side — remittance, cards, wallet, lending — working acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation problems for 2.2 million people.
  
  
The PMs who do best here are the ones who can hold a regulatory constraint and a growth funnel in their head at the same time.

jobs.description:
**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Credit team at Revolut creates and scales lending features that power global growth. They manage the entire product lifecycle, from backend systems to customer-facing experiences. By combining market insight, risk expertise, and technical precision, they deliver safe, forward-thinking solutions tailored to each region.
  
  
We’re looking for a Product Owner to lead our unsecured personal loan roadmap, including day-to-day operations, project execution, and risk assessment.
  
  
You’ll collaborate cross-functionally and communicate with senior management to be the go-to person for these features.
  
  
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Setting your team's goals, success metrics, and roadmap to align with company goals
* Driving maximum impact based on data analysis, market research, and company strategy
* Owning your team's products, from ideation through development, to launch, growth, and maintenance
* Working closely with Design and UX teams to define the customer journey and create an outstanding customer experience
* Liaising with Engineering to ensure effective delivery
* Partnering with other stakeholders, such as Marketing, Legal, and Strategy teams

**What You'll Need**

* 3+ years of experience at a high-growth tech company or in banking/finance-related business areas (acquiring, payments, investments, cryptocurrency, insurance, etc.)
* 2+ years of proven success leading loan products
* 1+ years of experience managing people
* Outstanding communication skills
* An eye for great UX/UI and an impeccable understanding of design best practices
* High analytical acumen along with solid business sense that guides ROI-based prioritisation
* Experience formulating and driving a focused product vision, and owning the narrative with leadership, customers, and partners
* Experience leading product development and launch from scratch
* A readiness to provide insight and deliver measurable results under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment
* An entrepreneurial drive to never settle

**Nice to have**

* A STEM degree

* Strong understanding and practical application of **US GAAP, particularly ASC 606** (Revenue from Contracts with Customers).
* Experience within asset management, banking, private equity, alternative investments, or broader financial services environments is strongly preferred.
* Solid knowledge of general ledger accounting, account reconciliations, financial analysis, and month-end close processes.
* Proven ability to interpret complex fee arrangements, investment management agreements, and incentive compensation structures, and resolve related accounting issues.

jobs.description:
**Company** | Hybon Technologies Private Limited  
**Location** | The Executive Centre, 7th Floor, Worldmark 4, Aerocity, New Delhi  
**Employment Type** | Full-time  
**Reporting To** | Chief Financial Officer

Role Overview

Hybon Technologies is looking for a **Head of Accounts** to lead the accounting function for its domestic trading and export business in mobile phones, electronics and IT products. The role owns the books of accounts, financial close, statutory compliance, audit coordination and internal controls. The successful candidate will lead the accounts team and work closely with sales, procurement, logistics and banking teams to keep financial records accurate and resolve discrepancies promptly.

Key Responsibilities

* **Accounting and financial close** — Oversee the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, fixed assets and intercompany balances. Lead monthly and year-end closing and prepare financial statements and supporting schedules.
* **GST and tax compliance** — Oversee GST returns, GSTR-2B reconciliations, input tax credit, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Manage TDS deductions, deposits and returns, and coordinate with tax advisors on statutory filings and notices.
* **Import and export accounting** — Review invoices, bills of entry, shipping bills, customs duties, freight and landed costs. Monitor foreign currency receivables and payables, exchange differences and export realisations. Coordinate with banks and internal teams on remittance documentation and support GST refund claims where applicable.
* **Inventory and cost controls** — Reconcile inventory records with the books and physical stock counts. Investigate stock discrepancies, review valuation and landed costs, and oversee IMEI or serial-number reconciliation where applicable.
* **Receivables, payables and cash flow** — Monitor customer and vendor ageing, advances and credit balances. Drive account confirmations and dispute resolution, review payment schedules and prepare cash flow forecasts for management.
* **Management reporting** — Prepare monthly reports on profitability, gross margins, inventory, overdue receivables and working capital. Explain material variances and flag issues that require management action.
* **Audits and internal controls** — Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits. Maintain supporting documentation, close audit observations and strengthen review controls for invoicing, payments, credit notes and journal entries.
* **Team leadership** — Supervise and develop the accounts team, set clear responsibilities and review deadlines, and improve accounting processes and ERP workflows.

Qualifications and Experience

* CA preferred. CMA, M.Com or B.Com candidates with relevant senior accounting experience may also be considered.
* 8–12 years of accounting experience, including at least 3 years leading an accounts team.
* Experience in trading, distribution or import/export is preferred. Exposure to mobile phones, electronics or IT hardware is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience in financial closing, GST, TDS, inventory accounting, reconciliations and audit coordination.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or a comparable ERP, along with strong Excel skills for reconciliations and management reporting.
* Ability to lead a team, meet statutory and reporting deadlines, and communicate clearly with management, auditors, banks and business teams.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per month

Work Location: In per

6. Compliance and internal coordination

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fin

About the Role

We are looking for a Manager – Credit Underwriting in our commercial underwriting team across multiple clients. The role will combine hands-on credit expertise, client management, and team leadership. Key Responsibilities

* Perform and review financial and credit analysis, including financial statements, ratio analysis, cash flows, liquidity, leverage, profitability, working capital, AR/AP aging and other key credit indicators.

* Manage and develop internal team, including work allocation, quality review, coaching and capability building.
* Drive process improvement, standardization, automation and risk-monitoring initiatives, and proactively communicate key risks, trends and recommendations to clients.

What we are looking for

* 5+ years of experience in commercial financial analysis, within banking, lending, fintech or financial services; experience with a US commercial lender.
* Strong understanding of financial statement analysis, credit appraisal, ratio analysis, cash-flow and working capital assessment, with sound credit judgment.
* Strong credit judgment and attention to detail, including ability to identify financial, operational and qualitative risks from multiple information sources.
* Excellent client-facing, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand ambiguous requirements and develop practical solutions.
* Should have strong understanding of Advanced MS Excel and financial analysis/modeling skills.
* Exposure to credit underwriting, financial spreading and banking/transaction data .

Educational Qualifications

* CA / CA Inter / Semi-qualified CA preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
* Equivalent qualifications with relevant credit risk/underwriting experience may also be considered.

jobs.title: Head of India
jobs.description:
**The Role**
India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.
  
  
You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.
  
  
As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.
  
  
Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.
* Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.
* Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.
* The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.
* Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.
* The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.
* The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

**Who You Are**

* 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.
* Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.
* Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.
* A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.
* A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance

The programs in question are those in which technology constituted only one of several concurrent workstreams, and where the principal challenge lay not in solution design but in enabling several thousand individuals across plants, markets, corporate functions and partner organisations to adopt fundamentally different ways of working.

The role owns the end-to-end shaping, mobilisation and delivery of enterprise transformation – process reengineering, operating model change, digital and data platforms, and the change management that makes the new way of working stick – with accountability for measurable business value, not go-live sign-off.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Applied AI
jobs.description:
**The role**
You own a set of enterprise accounts once they go live, and your job is to grow them. That means making sure delivery lands, the client sees results in their own numbers, and each account has a clear plan for what we do next with them.
  
  
You work with the client's business leaders on one side and our forward deployed engineers (FDEs) on the other. You run discovery with the client, turn their business logic into a call flow, and hand the FDE a clear spec for the workflow. When the FDE is deep in a complex build, you write the agent prompt yourself.
  
  
This is not a sales role. You grow accounts by delivering value the client can measure, and by spotting where else in their business we can do the same.
  
  
**Requirements**
**What you'll do**

* Run discovery. Understand the use case and the client's process, find the real pain point, and agree the north star metric with the client so everyone knows what outcome the agent has to deliver
* Design the call flow. Translate business logic into a call flow and conversation design, then brief the FDE on the workflow to build
* Build agents. Write and iterate production prompts, especially when the FDE is busy on a complex workflow
* Do RCA. When results dip, listen to the conversations, work out why they failed (prompt, data, flow or telephony) and drive the fix
* Own the client relationship. Be the person the client calls first. Run governance calls, reviews and escalations, and build trust with stakeholders from operations teams up to business heads
* Make delivery happen. Plan and run the project with the FDEs: scope, timelines, dependencies on the client's tech and data teams, go-lives. Unblock things before they slip
* Run on numbers. Own the account's metrics (connect rate, conversion, collections, cost per outcome). Build the analysis, explain what moved and why, and turn it into the next change to the agent
* Build the account roadmap. For every account, write a strategic plan for expansion: new use cases, new teams, more volume. Size each one, build the business case and take it to the client
* Sell through value. Pitch upsell and cross-sell with evidence from your own account's results, working with sales and leadership on commercials
* Test and improve. Run A/B tests on agents, prompts and voices, and read them out

**Who we're looking for**
Two backgrounds have worked best for this role:
  
  

* A growth product manager, ideally with about 2 years of consulting before moving into product, or
* A consultant with 3 to 4 years at a top-tier consulting firm

Either way, you have:
  
  

* Strong client handling. You're comfortable in a room with senior stakeholders and can manage difficult conversations
* Sharp analytics. You can pull and work the data yourself (SQL, spreadsheets) and turn it into a recommendation
* Project management discipline across several workstreams and people you don't manage
* Commercial instinct: you can see where an account can grow and make the case for it
* Clear, short writing
* Prompt engineering experience. We don't mean using ChatGPT or Claude day to day; we mean you have built agents that carry out a specific task and have run at scale with real users
* Conversation design sense. You can read a transcript, see where it went wrong, and fix the flow or the prompt

**Nice to have**

* Experience at a voice or conversational AI company, or deploying AI for enterprise clients
* BFSI background: lending, collections or insurance operati

* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
* Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability in CCAAS Migration, Amazon Connect, Python and AWS

**The Role**

The CTO is a senior executive responsible for defining and governing the company’s overall technology strategy, ensuring alignment with business growth, regulatory requirements, and investor expectations. This role operates at the enterprise level, owning strategic direction, technology risk mitigation, organisational performance and delivery outcomes through accountable senior leaders.

The CTO is a core member of the executive leadership team, reporting to the CEO and working closely with the executive team, with regular engagement with the Board, regulators and investors. Success in this role is defined by long-term platform scalability, resilience and commercial value creation.

This is a strategy-first executive role with accountability for delivery and production outcomes through senior leaders, requiring technical judgement and leadership at Board and regulator level. Day-to-day coding and engineering execution sit with the engineering teams.

BMS leads the delivery of digital platforms such as the

and
